card.name: Words just before an idea or doctrine
card.fires_on: Verbs, brackets and linking words in general web text that come right before an abstract idea, doctrine or theory is named, such as discovered, spread or an opening parenthesis. It is mostly seen where a noun like communism, gravity or ideas is expected next.

modes.label: Verb before a concept
modes.description: A verb such as discovered or spread that is followed by a theory, message or idea.
modes.example: Every high school student knows that Isaac Newton<< discovered>> gravity, that Charles Darwin discovered evolution,

modes.label: Opening bracket before an ism
modes.description: A parenthesis that introduces an abstract term or example, such as Communism.

modes.label: Link word before ideas
modes.description: A preposition that comes before his ideas or a message.
modes.example: gain publicity<< for>> himself and his ideas.

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward ideology and era terms like Christianity, socialism and modern, and away from hardware and infrastructure words.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come just before a belief system or big idea gets named.
